title: LibraryEntry
description: One entry in Backdrop's library.json (URI -> video file). Pushed by Curator. An entry names a filePath of its own or sets usesDefault, in which case Backdrop plays its configured default clip (ADR 0073) — exactly one of the two, never both and never neither.

filePath.description: Absolute path on Backdrop's SD card.

usesDefault.description: This record has no visualizer of its own — play Backdrop's default clip. Distinct from the entry being absent, which still means 'this tag is in nothing Curator knows'.

contentHash.description: e.g. sha256:... — lets sync detect updates.
